description.pl: Repozytoria, issues, pull requesty i GitHub Actions: przeglad, komentarze, nowe zgloszenia.
description.en: Repositories, issues, pull requests and GitHub Actions: review, comments, new issues.

help.pl: Utworz token (fine-grained) na github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new: wybierz repozytoria i nadaj uprawnienia, ktorych Pipe ma uzywac (np. Contents, Issues, Pull requests: odczyt i zapis).
help.en: Create a fine-grained token at github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new: pick the repositories and grant what Pipe should use (e.g. Contents, Issues, Pull requests: read and write).
